workflow: Use this skill for DingTalk document and knowledge-base requests only.
Use scripts/dt_helper.sh to obtain tokens and convert DINGTALK_MY_USER_ID to DINGTALK_MY_OPERATOR_ID when needed.
Use references/api.md for concrete DingTalk document API requests.
